title: Option to show the date above the time
line: The Digital Clock can now show the date above the time or after it, not only before or below.
explanation: The Digital Clock's date placement setting only offered Adaptive, Always beside time (date before the time) and Always below time, so there was no way to put the date above the time or to its right. The layout states also hard-coded where the date goes for each mode. The change adds two new choices to the dateDisplayFormat enum (AboveTime, AfterTime, appended so existing configs keep their meaning) and splits the panel, one-line and desktop layout states into a shared base plus small child states that only differ in where the date is anchored, so switching between placements updates live. The settings combobox now lists Adaptive location, Always before time, Always after time, Always above time and Always below time.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: add options to show the date above or after the time

The date could only be placed before or below the time, so people who
prefer it above the time or to the right of it had no way to do that. Add
"Always above time" and "Always after time" placement options.

BUG: 519087

From ceb617fb1baeb4b28481a02584381e96035a19b9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 20:16:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: add options to show the date above or
 after the time

The date could only be placed before or below the time, so people who
prefer it above the time or to the right of it had no way to do that. Add
"Always above time" and "Always after time" placement options.

BUG: 519087

 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml     | 106 ++++++++++++++++++---
 applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml |  16 +++-
 applets/digital-clock/main.xml             |   4 +-
 3 files changed, 108 insertions(+), 18 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..48d3621aff 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -60,11 +60,11 @@ MouseArea {
     // if showing the date and the time in one line or
     // if the date/time zone cannot be fit with the smallest font to its designated space
     readonly property bool oneLineMode: {
-        if (Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 1) {
-            // BesideTime
+        if (Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 1 || Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 4) {
+            // BesideTime or AfterTime
             return true;
-        } else if (Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 2) {
-            // BelowTime
+        } else if (Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 2 || Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 3) {
+            // BelowTime or AboveTime
             return false;
         } else {
             // Adaptive
@@ -74,6 +74,9 @@ MouseArea {
         }
     }
 
+    readonly property bool dateAboveTime: Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 3
+    readonly property bool dateAfterTime: Plasmoid.configuration.dateDisplayFormat === 4
+
     property bool wasExpanded
     property int wheelDelta: 0
 
@@ -142,7 +145,6 @@ MouseArea {
     states: [
         State {
             name: "horizontalPanel"
-            when: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && !main.oneLineMode
 
             PropertyChanges {
                 main.Layout.fillHeight: true
@@ -187,6 +189,12 @@ MouseArea {
 
                 anchors.horizontalCenter: contentItem.horizontalCenter
             }
+        },
+
+        State {
+            name: "horizontalPanelDateBelow"
+            extend: "horizontalPanel"
+            when: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && !main.oneLineMode && !main.dateAboveTime
 
             AnchorChanges {
                 target: dateLabel
@@ -196,10 +204,25 @@ MouseArea {
             }
         },
 
+        State {
+            name: "horizontalPanelDateAbove"
+            extend: "horizontalPanel"
+            when: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && !main.oneLineMode && main.dateAboveTime
+
+            PropertyChanges {
+                labelsGrid.y: dateLabel.visible ? dateLabel.height : 0
+            }
+
+            AnchorChanges {
+                target: dateLabel
+
+                anchors.top: contentItem.top
+                anchors.horizontalCenter: labelsGrid.horizontalCenter
+            }
+        },
+
         State {
             name: "oneLineDate"
-            // the one-line mode has no effect on a vertical panel because it would never fit
-            when: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && main.oneLineMode
 
             PropertyChanges {
                 main.Layout.fillHeight: true
@@ -208,16 +231,12 @@ MouseArea {
                 main.Layout.maximumWidth: main.Layout.minimumWidth
 
                 contentItem.height: sizehelper.height
-                contentItem.width: (dateLabel.visible ? dateLabel.width + dateLabel.anchors.rightMargin : 0) + labelsGrid.width
 
                 dateLabel.height: timeLabel.height
                 dateLabel.width: dateLabel.paintedWidth
 
                 dateLabel.font.pixelSize: 1024
                 dateLabel.verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
-                // between date and time; they are styled the same, so
-                // a space is more appropriate than smallSpacing
-                dateLabel.anchors.rightMargin: timeMetrics.advanceWidth(" ")
                 dateLabel.fontSizeMode: Text.VerticalFit
 
                 timeLabel.height: sizehelper.height
@@ -234,6 +253,22 @@ MouseArea {
                 sizehelper.font.pixelSize: fontHelper.font.pixelSize
             }
 
+        },
+
+        State {
+            name: "oneLineDateBeforeTime"
+            extend: "oneLineDate"
+            // the one-line mode has no effect on a vertical panel because it would never fit
+            when: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && main.oneLineMode && !main.dateAfterTime
+
+            PropertyChanges {
+                contentItem.width: (dateLabel.visible ? dateLabel.width + dateLabel.anchors.rightMargin : 0) + labelsGrid.width
+
+                // between date and time; they are styled the same, so
+                // a space is more appropriate than smallSpacing
+                dateLabel.anchors.rightMargin: timeMetrics.advanceWidth(" ")
+            }
+
             AnchorChanges {
                 target: labelsGrid
 
@@ -248,6 +283,31 @@ MouseArea {
             }
         },
 
+        State {
+            name: "oneLineDateAfterTime"
+            extend: "oneLineDate"
+            when: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && main.oneLineMode && main.dateAfterTime
+
+            PropertyChanges {
+                contentItem.width: (dateLabel.visible ? dateLabel.width + dateLabel.anchors.leftMargin : 0) + labelsGrid.width
+
+                dateLabel.anchors.leftMargin: timeMetrics.advanceWidth(" ")
+            }
+
+            AnchorChanges {
+                target: labelsGrid
+
+                anchors.left: contentItem.left
+            }
+
+            AnchorChanges {
+                target: dateLabel
+
+                anchors.left: labelsGrid.right
+                anchors.verticalCenter: labelsGrid.verticalCenter
+            }
+        },
+
         State {
             name: "verticalPanel"
             when: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
@@ -300,7 +360,6 @@ MouseArea {
 
         State {
             name: "other"
-            when: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal
 
             PropertyChanges {
                 main.Layout.fillHeight: false
@@ -345,6 +404,12 @@ MouseArea {
                 sizehelper.fontSizeMode: Text.Fit
                 sizehelper.font.pixelSize: 1024
             }
+        },
+
+        State {
+            name: "otherDateBelow"
+            extend: "other"
+            when: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && !main.dateAboveTime
 
             AnchorChanges {
                 target: dateLabel
@@ -352,6 +417,23 @@ MouseArea {
                 anchors.top: labelsGrid.bottom
                 anchors.horizontalCenter: labelsGrid.horizontalCenter
             }
+        },
+
+        State {
+            name: "otherDateAbove"
+            extend: "other"
+            when: Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical && Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && main.dateAboveTime
+
+            PropertyChanges {
+                labelsGrid.y: dateLabel.visible ? dateLabel.height : 0
+            }
+
+            AnchorChanges {
+                target: dateLabel
+
+                anchors.top: contentItem.top
+                anchors.horizontalCenter: labelsGrid.horizontalCenter
+            }
         }
     ]
 
diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml b/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml

                 enabled: showDate.checked

+                textRole: "label"

+                    { label: i18n("Always before time"), value: 1 },
+                    { label: i18n("Always after time"), value: 4 },

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
index 6716b906c5..4f248614e7 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
@@ -104,11 +104,13 @@
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
     <entry name="dateDisplayFormat" type="Enum">
-      <label>Whether the date should be shown below or beside the time</label>
+      <label>Whether the date should be shown above, below or beside the time</label>
       <choices name="Settings::dateDisplayFormat">
         <choice name="Adaptive" />
         <choice name="BesideTime" />
         <choice name="BelowTime" />

+        <choice name="AfterTime" />

       <default>0</default>
